aboutText: Tile & Stone Restoration Melbourne has been providing expert restoration services to Melbourne and surrounding suburbs for many years. We specialise in tile and grout cleaning, shower regrouting, pressure washing, deck restoration, carpet cleaning, and timber floor polishing. Our team covers all suburbs within 100km of Melbourne CBD, ensuring convenient and high-quality results for residential and commercial clients.
servicesText: We offer a full range of restoration services to keep your tiles, stone, and surfaces in top condition. From deep cleaning to protective sealing, we serve all Melbourne suburbs with professionalism and precision.
